sources.title: bge-small-zh-v1.5: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview bge-small-zh-v1.5 is a Chinese text embedding model developed by BAAI that converts arbitrary Chinese text into low-dimensional dense vectors for retrieval, classification, clustering, and semantic search tasks. The model belongs to the BGE (BAAI General Embedding) family, which achieved top rankings on the C-MTEB Chinese benchmark.
